$comment: #1053 item 4: tools the gate REFUSES to run without, pinned exactly.
The Rust toolchain is pinned to a single version in rust-toolchain.toml and nobody argues about
it. A test RUNNER deserves the same treatment for a stronger reason: it decides which tests ran.
Two nextest versions can disagree about defaults that change a verdict -- --no-tests, retries,
slow-timeout termination -- so a green produced by an unpinned runner is a green from an
ci/gate.ps1 reads this file before its first stage and REFUSES on absent-or-mismatched. It never
falls back to `cargo test`: a fallback would publish a green from a different instrument than the
one this repository measured, which is the whole class ci/gate-nextest.tests.ps1 guards.
